text:
olivia_sales: Hey team — VegaBio wants a 72h POC. Their infra is on-prem and they asked whether PrivateLink (VPCE) or VPC peering to our transit VPC is faster and what minimal route/SN/SG changes we need. Also asked if we can give a short-lived smoke key.

max_se: PrivateLink almost always wins for speed: customer creates an interface endpoint in their VPC (or a VPC that terminates their VPN/TGW) and enables private DNS. No route-table changes on our side. Recommend 2 AZs.

arin_infra: Quick checklist I hand out:
- Subnets: private subnets in 2 AZs (subnet IDs)
- SG on endpoint: ingress TCP 443 from customer app CIDR; egress 443 allowed
- If they must peer: non-overlapping CIDRs, create+accept PCX, add route in their RT -> pcx-xxxx, and ensure our RT has return route if cross-account.

zoe_security: We will not issue org-wide long-lived keys for a POC. We can provide ephemeral tokens (6h) scoped to the POC and rate-limited. Also need their egress/NAT plan and whether their on-prem DNS forwards to AWS resolver.

olivia_sales: They asked: "If we enable Private DNS, do SDKs resolve private-api.redwood to VPCE ENIs automatically?"

max_se: Yes, with private DNS enabled, regional service hostnames resolve to ENI IPs. If on-prem DNS is authoritative and doesnt forward, advise them to either: (a) add a split-horizon entry, (b) forward relevant domain to the VPC resolver, or (c) /etc/hosts for the POC.

arin_infra: Minimal VPCE CLI we give to customers (they run in their account):
````bash
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint \\n  --vpc-id vpc-0aaa111 \\n  --service-name com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-zzzz \\n  --vpc-endpoint-type Interface \\n  --subnet-ids subnet-a subnet-b \\n  --security-group-ids sg-0123abcd \\n  --private-dns-enabled
````
Then test: `dig +short private-api.redwood-inference.internal` -> should return ENI IPs.

kyle_support: For the smoke curl test we can issue a single-use ephemeral token. Example test:
````bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL>\" https://private-api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/healthz
````
Expect 200 {\"status\":\"ok\"}.

zoe_security: Also flag: if customer requires mTLS, thats an opt-in enterprise setting and will add time. Capture legal/security signoff before issuing tokens.

olivia_sales: Action items: (1) arin: paste a trimmed SG+RT snippet to send to their infra contact (ASAP) (2) kyle: prep ephemeral token steps + README (EOD) (3) zoe: minimal security artifact for their audit (today). Ill schedule kickoff after they confirm subnets. Thanks!
